headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven expansion while others saw modest top‑line gains.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI services contributed noticeably to profit uplift at HCLTech, Infosys and TCS. Margin guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Coforge. Dividend payouts remained steady across most peers.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Companies reporting AI revenue growth (Infosys 29%, HCLTech $219 m, TCS $3.1 bn) posted higher profit growth.

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance cuts
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and saw operating margin dip to 21%; other firms kept or raised margins.

themes.title: Strong top‑line expansion in mid‑tier players
themes.detail: Coforge delivered 53.6% YoY revenue growth and lifted EBIT margin guidance; LTM and Tech Mahindra also posted double‑digit growth.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
11.5% YoY revenue growth with 21% profit jump, driven by AI revenue.

laggards.why: Only 1.5% YoY revenue growth and a cut in FY27 guidance.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and guidance was flat.
